title: Girls by Flocked Christmas Tree, Chicago TV - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Two playful young girls sit on the living room floor in front of an elaborate white flocked Christmas tree adorned with round bauble ornaments. One girl giggles with an open-mouth grin, while the younger child squints happily into the camera flash. Beside them stands an early 1960s CRT television set against sheer window drapery. The photo margin indicates development by Skrudland in Chicago in May 1961, documenting the preceding Christmas season of 1960 with classic mid-century holiday decor.
